decisions_log.decision: Use Next.js Link component for the 'Return to Home' button rather than a plain <a> tag.
decisions_log.rationale: next/link provides client-side navigation and prefetching, which is the idiomatic approach in Next.js App Router. The href='/' satisfies AC2.

decisions_log.decision: Copy for the helpful explanation: 'The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved. Check the URL or head back to the homepage.'
decisions_log.rationale: Professional, plain-language tone as specified by the BA. Deferred decision resolved by SWE as permitted by the sketch.

decisions_log.decision: Outer wrapper uses bg-zinc-50/dark:bg-black and inner main uses bg-white/dark:bg-black, mirroring the structure of page.tsx exactly.
decisions_log.rationale: Ensures visual consistency with the existing homepage and automatic dark theme inheritance via Tailwind's dark: variant.

files_changed.summary: Next.js special-file 404 handler. Centered hero layout with 'Page not found' h1, plain-language explanation, and 'Return to Home' link. Uses zinc color palette and bg-foreground/text-background button style from page.tsx. Inherits Header, Footer, and ThemeProvider automatically via RootLayout.
Unit tests for the 404 page covering AC1 (heading + explanation), AC2 (Return to Home link href), AC3 (dark-mode class on wrapper), and AC4 (h1 first heading, semantic main element).

self_assessment.notes: All 30 tests pass (6 new for NotFound, 24 pre-existing). ESLint and tsc --noEmit both exit clean. The page lives in app/not-found.tsx, uses zinc palette tokens from page.tsx, applies bg-foreground text-background for the primary action, and is centered with flex flex-col items-center justify-center. Layout wrapping (Header/Footer/ThemeProvider) is provided automatically by RootLayout.
